decision_to_unlock: Determine whether existing voice discovery routes already reach the correct professional service pages and whether GEO assets keep individual Audio+ orders separate from B2B production.
finding: The official-site HTML snapshots show an existing catalogue/profile/request path and dedicated professional radio/video forms. Repository GEO answers contain a separate audience-segmentation risk: several short-price pages route radio/video intent to Audio+ while the surface is labelled for business.
limitations: Official service pages were served from cached HTML crawls aged approximately 3–5 months.
The GitHub Pages GEO URLs could not be retrieved in this read-only run; deployment and indexing are not established.
No order form was submitted and no CRM, event, payment, or conversion behavior was tested.
The Audio+ offer boundary is from a separately saved 2026-11-20 review in open PR #67 and needs fresh primary-source confirmation before any price or offer edit.
next_decision: Prepare a repository-only revision of existing GEO assets to distinguish short individual Audio+ orders from the corresponding B2B studio-service route; do not deploy.
